_comment: Golden fixture trees the exporter deliberately does NOT serve (#2387).
Each one's ROOT _defaults.yaml carries a defaults: value that is not a number,
so the exporter drops the whole file (parse_failed, #1957) and /metrics serves
none of it. They are kept as merge-core corpus: the semantics they pin cannot be
written in a root shape the exporter accepts. Parity on them proves the two merge
readers agree with each other, not that they describe what is served.
`da-guard served-values` over every tests/golden/fixtures/*/conf.d. A tree listed
here must exit 3; every other tree must exit 0. Do not add a tree here to make
that test green: fix the fixture, unless it pins a merge rule no served shape can.
Do not regenerate golden.json to move these trees into a served shape (see the

trees.l0-only: root defaults hold a nested `threshold:` map and a string `alert_group`: root-level scalar override inside a nested map
trees.full-l0-l3: root defaults hold a string `level`, a nested `threshold:` map and a `pages:` array: 4-level nested-map merge and array replace
trees.array-replace: root defaults hold a `receivers:` array and a nested `threshold:` map: arrays replace, not concat
trees.opt-out-null: root defaults hold a nested `threshold:` map and a string `alert_group`: null on a nested non-reserved key keeps the inherited value
trees.metadata-skipped: root defaults hold a `_metadata:` map and a nested `threshold:` map: `_metadata` is never inherited
